description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers a competitive annual salary and the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development. We are looking for a leader who is passionate about delivering high-quality nursing services and fostering a supportive environment.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and promoting an exceptional standard of care for our residents. This is an excellent opportunity for a visionary leader to drive clinical excellence and operational efficiency within a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 3-5 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and best practices
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience.
